1.title: Harness Engineering: Building the Production Cage for Powerful Domain Agents — Mike Chambers, AWS
1.author: AI Engineer
1.hook: Live walkthrough of separating agent concerns (memory, tools, scaling, observability) into independently scalable infrastructure components, with a concrete CLI example showing how configuration replaces agent code.

1.title: Speech-to-Speech Model Research at Google DeepMind — Valeria Wu Fon & Tom Ouyang, Google DeepMind
1.author: AI Engineer
1.hook: Speech-to-speech models trained end-to-end on multimodal data (audio, video, text) can preserve domain-specific terminology and intonation without explicit rules — and the field faces a three-way tension between latency, task intelligence, and multimodal input that can't be solved by turning up one knob.

2.title: Unlocking the Business of Brand Deals on YouTube /w @hopescope
2.author: Creator Insider
2.hook: YouTube senior director and 8M-subscriber creator break down how automated midrolls, dynamic brand segments, and creator-brand matching actually work — with specific monetization mechanics.

3.title: Voice Agents Can Just Do Things — Charlie Guo, OpenAI
3.author: AI Engineer
3.hook: Speech-to-action (voice triggering tool calls) is the neglected mode; your app's existing endpoints convert directly into tools a voice model can call.

1.title: "My name is... my name is...": A Linguistic Map for Voice Agents — Midam Kim, ServiceNow
1.author: AI Engineer
1.hook: A structured linguistic framework (8-cell grid) that maps voice agent failures to specific architectural levels—sounds, words, interaction, mental model—showing why fixes to one layer don't hold without the others.

2.title: Act, Confirm, or Stop? Smarter behavior for AI assistants, wearables & robots — Amit Desai, Roku
2.author: AI Engineer
2.hook: A framework (OUCH — Outcome User Cost Heuristic) for tuning confidence thresholds in voice/embodied AI by modeling the asymmetric cost of different failure modes, not by chasing accuracy alone.

3.title: Realtime Voice Agents with Frontier Intelligence — Bohan Li, EliseAI
3.author: AI Engineer
3.hook: Three concrete optimization tricks for running voice agents on slow models without latency (speculative transcription, background tool calls with context injection, prefix-cached speech synthesis).

1.title: 5 Voice Agent Failure Modes You'll Hit in Week One — Venky B, Plivo
1.author: AI Engineer
1.hook: Production voice agents hit latency walls (750–1,200ms vs 550ms target) and half fail on data collection; Plivo's CEO shares five failure modes with concrete fixes (field-level validation instead of end-to-end transcription, sub-300ms model selection, synthesis normalization).

2.title: I Monitored Crime Audio. Voice Agents Scare Me More. — Sumanyu Sharma, Hamming AI
2.author: AI Engineer
2.hook: A public safety engineer who monitored crime audio at scale now audits voice agents and finds ~10% failure rates; adversarial testing breaks 1 in 5 agents in production.

3.title: Tolan: Voice-First AI Companion — Paula Dozsa, Tolan
3.author: AI Engineer
3.hook: Voice-first LLM apps invalidate text-chat assumptions; specific engineering: turn detection at 60ms latency, per-turn routing by emotional stakes, context reassembly instead of caching, memory as retrieval not transcript.
